method: Complex Dicke coefficients; analytic-gradient L-BFGS-B multistart with purity formula. Independent full-Hilbert-space Pauli expectations with symmetric multiplicities. Sparse candidates additionally checked in exact SymPy arithmetic.

entries.coefficientConvention: Normalized amplitudes ordered r=0,...,n in the Dicke basis. Each pair is [real, imaginary].
entries.notes: Explicit state attains the displayed value to numerical precision. The search alone does not establish global optimality. A separate bound certificate is required for proven status.
